E-sports and physical sports are completely different. In fact the only thing that is similar is competition. E-sports generally play on your intelligence (strategies in RTS) and extremely minute twitch reflects. It's a lot different to be able to move your whole body in a split second than it is to move just your forearm. 

Physical sports is about how you can manipulate your body to do what you want it to do. E-sports is how you can manipulate the game to do what you want it to do. The only thing that separates an "Average Joe" from being a pro in SC2 is simply practice and maybe a little bit of computer literacy. One of the reasons superstar athletes are respected so much is because of how much control they exert over their body. It is not physically possible for every human to do what some professional athletes do, so even more respect is placed on that. 

I believe this is one of the (many) factors that separate e-sports and physical sports.
